stage: Supplementary published-method comparison, fixed after seeing the main experiment
bias_type: Bernstein, for arbitrary bounded rewards; do not use the one-hot reward assumption
simultaneous_confidence: alpha/(M+1) for M candidate lower bounds and the baseline complement lower bound
mc_randomness: Frozen per log/policy before attacking, independent of rewards; attacker knows resulting final rule
attack: Same minimum-true-value binary-flip attack as in the main experiment
qualification: Original authors' Efron-Stein estimator code, called unchanged through an AST loader to avoid unrelated JAX/OpenML dependencies. Monte Carlo proxies are numerical approximations. The corruption-aware wrapper and baseline-contrast adaptation are our additions.
